models.notes: Flagship transcendental pricer. bs_call_scalar wraps the pure-f64 bs_call_f64 (both exported); the shipped Greeks differentiate bs_call_f64.
Black-76 forward call. Shares the lognormal european-call invariant family with bs_call, so the same kind-level invariants instantiate against a second model (kind-reuse demonstration).

Closed-form 2-step CRR European call. Pure arithmetic + ITE (no transcendentals), so its pricing structure lowers to cvc5 -- the shell's genuine proven-over-reals model. General-depth CRR needs induction and is held out.

DEFECTIVE reference model (sprint in-region-break deliverable). Identical to tr_crr_call_2step but with the discount factor DROPPED -- it returns the raw risk-neutral expected payoff, not its present value (a real, common finance bug: forgetting to discount). It conforms to the european_call_fixed_depth kind yet VIOLATES the no-arbitrage upper bound C <= s inside its valid input region (verified in-domain witness s=1.0 k=0.5 u=2.0 d=0.5 q=0.5 gives price 1.125 > spot 1.0). See invariant shoals.inv.call_upper_bounded_by_spot.crr_nodisc_defect.v1.

Per the no-unobserved-tier / no-expected-tier-for-deferred rule this entry carries no expected_tier_per_pin. The property + a fast-refuting corrupted twin stay in properties/canonpricing.ch as the reproducer; contract_gate does not gate deferred invariants.
